name: cleanuperr
description: ## Introducing cleanuperr ### How it works 1. Add excluded file names to prevent malicious files from being downloaded by qBittorrent. 2. cleanuperr goes through all items in Sonarr's queue at every 5th minute. 3. For each queue item, a call is made to qBittorrent to get the stats of the torrent. 4. If a torrent is found to be marked as completed, but with 0 downloaded bytes, cleanuperr calls Sonarr to add that torrent to the blocklist. 5. If any malicious torrents have been found, cleanuperr calls Sonarr to automatically search again. ### Environment variables Multiple Sonarr/Radarr instances can be specified using this format: SONARR__INSTANCES__NUMBER__URL SONARR__INSTANCES__NUMBER__APIKEY where NUMBER starts from 0.
